title: Live: Israel strikes central Beirut as Iran attack leaves two dead near Tel Aviv
summary: Iran's Supreme National Security Council late on Tuesday confirmed Israeli claims that the country's security chief Ali Larijani had been killed. Israel had previously announced that the top Iranian official was killed in an overnight air strike. Read our liveblog to see how the day's events unfolded.
contentText: Iranian intelligence ​minister ‌Esmail Khatib ⁠was "eliminated" in ‌a strike overnight, ⁠Israel's ⁠Defence ​Minister Israel Katz ​said on Wednesday. Iran has not yet confirmed ‌Khatib's reported death. The news comes after Israeli strikes on central Beirut – which came without warning – left at least 12 dead and 41 injured. Follow our live blog for the latest developments.
